name: Dánszentmiklós (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Dánszentmiklós (a red and white shield with a bend, apples, a book and a fleur-de-lis) above a yellow scroll inscribed DÁNSZENTMIKLÓS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
